result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with residential row houses but lacks basic crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or refuge islands, resulting in high exposure for anyone attempting to cross the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at a wide intersection increases pedestrian exposure and reduces driver awareness.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend significant time in the path of traffic without a refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time on this wide roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure at a wide intersection adjacent to a gas station. Pedestrians face long, unmarked crossing distances and multiple conflict points due to wide, undefined driveway openings.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated or protected space.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground intersection area

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Openings
hazards.description: The gas station has very wide, undefined access points that create numerous conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the gas station entrance

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear on the roadway and sidewalk surfaces which can cause tripping or instability.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow and clearly define the gas station entrances to reduce the width of the conflict zone for pedestrians on the sidewalk.

result.summary: The image shows a wide residential street with minimal pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, there are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic calming measures visible at the junction, creating a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians lack a designated, protected space to cross the wide roadway at the junction.

result.summary: A residential intersection that lacks marked crosswalks and visible traffic control devices. While sidewalks are present, parked vehicles near the corners and the absence of crossing infrastructure create a less-than-ideal environment for pedestrians.
